sloka: स तस्य वाक्यं प्रतिपूर्णघोषं ज्याशब्दमुग्रं च निशम्य राजा ।आसाद्य सौमित्रिमवस्थितं तं कोपान्वितो वाक्यमुवाच रक्षः ।। ६.५९.९५ ।।।।
transliteration: sa tasya vākyaṁ pratipūrṇaghoṣaṁ jyāśabdamugraṁ ca niśamya rājā ।āsādya saumitrimavasthitaṁ taṁ kopānvito vākyamuvāca rakṣaḥ ।। 6.59.95 ।।।।

translations.english: Saumithri who was not depressed in spirit (by Ravana's attack) addressing Ravana who was stretching his bow said "Oh! Lord of night rangers, Be aware. You ought not to fight with vanaras."
